description: Make a short video of one bitHuman house character saying `text` word for word, in its own voice. Returns video_url (an MP4 that plays inline and expires after 7 days), duration_seconds and share_url, labelled AI character. Example: {"character": "wise-pup", "text": "Welcome back! Ready for today's lesson?"}. Limits: `text` is 3 to 200 characters and at most 19 seconds when spoken (about 15 s is typical); one video at a time per user; 10 videos per user per UTC day; the same character and text again replays the earlier clip at once. Errors come back as isError with one sentence saying what to do: an unknown character (call list_characters), text too short or too long (rewrite it), personal information such as a phone number, email or street address (remove it), busy (retry in a minute), the daily limit (try again after 00:00 UTC), resting (try later). To hold a conversation in character, write each reply yourself and call this tool once per reply.

text.description: The exact words the character says, 3 to 200 characters (at most 19 seconds of speech). No personal information.

name: make_character_video
